Celebrities defend Katrina Kaif against post-pregnancy body shaming

Actors Khushboo Sundar and Ali Zafar have defended actress Katrina Kaif against online trolling regarding her post-pregnancy appearance. Sundar stated that no woman is accountable to anyone who feels entitled to comment on her body. Zafar urged men to 'correct themselves' in response to the trolling. Hrithik Roshan reportedly liked an Instagram post defending Kaif.
